subject: Working with inputs generated in renderUI

messages.author: 3c2ee2957846782f
messages.subject: Working with inputs generated in renderUI
parts:
So I've generated a length of numericInputs in a renderUI function in server.R, and they show fine through a uiOutput in UI.R. They even pre-populate correctly with the values from the source tables.

However, I'd also like them to be reactive, so as the user changes the spinner values, they kick off the chain of dependencies for items that rely on those values. I'm having trouble with this part, in that conceptually there is a series of inputs generated in server.R, and even if I make them reactive (or so I think), they are not. Ideas welcome.

--- relevant snippet of server.R ---

require(data.table) #faster than data frames!

values <- reactiveValues()
# initialize wt here
values$wt <- wt

output$namesP <- renderUI({
dat <- indic.dt[DRI_RISK_TYPE == "PRC",list(DRI_DESCRIPTION,Indicator_ID,WEIGHT)] 
  lapply(1:nrow(dat), function(i) {
   descrip <- dat[i]$DRI_DESCRIPTION
   indicator <- dat[i]$Indicator_ID
p(numericInput(inputId="Indicator",label="",min=0,max=1,step=0.1,value=getWt(indicator,values$wt)),descrip)
})
})

messages.subject: Re: Working with inputs generated in renderUI
parts: Each numericInput must have a unique ID (for example, inputId=paste0("Indicator", i) ). If multiple inputs have the same ID simultaneously then I believe all but one of them will be ignored.
